title: P2 Guidelines operations, papyrus guidelines CLI and the door
description:
What: one definition for CLI, MCP, newsroom client and the GraphQL door.

Files:
- src/papyrus_content/images/operations.py (operation table): guidelines_get, guidelines_resolve, guidelines_diff, guidelines_save, guidelines_history with kind writing|image and optional section; kind image delegates to the image_profile_* handlers (kept as aliases); regenerate cli_generated.py, mcp_tools.generated.json, lib/images/operations.generated.ts
- src/papyrus_content/guidelines/handlers.py; src/papyrus_content/cli wiring for `papyrus guidelines show|resolve|diff|save|history` (writes by default, --dry-run previews, --help sends nothing)
- amplify/functions/image-service/{schema.ts,wire.ts,resource.ts}: guidelinesRead(op,input,actorKind) and guidelinesWrite(op,input,requestId,actorKind); IAM read/write on the payload bucket prefix newsroom/payloads/item/
- src/papyrus_content/image_service.py: route the new fields; caller identity from AppSync only; admins save, editors read; agent cannot change constraints (human_required); requestId makes writes repeatable
- features_backend/guidelines-door.feature, features_backend/guidelines-cli.feature

Acceptance checks:
- The operation table test proves CLI flags, MCP tools and the TS client are generated from the same entries.
- An editor's save is not_authorized; an admin's save creates a version; an agent's constraint change is human_required and saves nothing.
- Deploy to Pilobolus first (one data API deploy bundled with the version bump), then all seven sites in one batch.

Gherkin scenarios:
- An admin saves writing guidelines through the door
- An editor can read but not save guidelines
- An agent cannot change a binding constraint even with an admin's session
- Repeating a write with the same request id returns the first answer
- The read door refuses a write operation
- papyrus guidelines save writes unless --dry-run
- papyrus guidelines diff shows the change and saves nothing
- papyrus guidelines resolve prints each field with where it came from

Design: docs/plans/guidelines-as-data.md. Gherkin specs are required and ship in the same PR. Text lives in S3, never inline in DynamoDB; no new GSI; no subscriptions. Style and voice wording is data, never code.
